_comment: Lightning Phases 5 and 9, remediation two. NOT YET APPLIED: every name below is a promise until the owner installs 20260926045132 after 20260926023047. THE SEAT IS THE ANCHOR: lightning_pool_session.anchor_seat_id (NOT NULL, foreign key to table_seats, one open session per anchor) is written by the conversion and by the new fn_lightning_pool_enter; fn_lightning_pool_stack returns the anchor seat's stack; two deferred constraint triggers on table_seats (trg_table_seats_lightning_pool_on_insert, trg_table_seats_lightning_pool_follows_seat, both calling fn_table_seats_lightning_pool_follows_seat) move a player into and out of the pool with the seat; trg_table_seats_lightning_anchor_guard (fn_table_seats_lightning_anchor_guard) refuses with PLT01 LIGHTNING_HAND_IN_PROGRESS any change to the anchor of a player in a live Lightning hand (fn_lightning_player_in_hand) except by that hand's settlement. A HALT IS A STOP ONLY ONCE SEEN: tables.dealing_halt_observed_at, stamped by fn_cash_table_observe_dealing_halt from the engine's halt gate; fn_cash_cluster_commit_lightning counts incomplete hand_state_snapshots instead of hand_history and waits for every member table with a live engine lease to observe its halt; fn_cash_cluster_open_table opens a table halted in a halted Cluster. fn_lightning_anchor_is_live_eligible is the population's seated predicate asked of one seat, used by the pool door, the formation filter and begin_dealing. fn_lightning_form_hand gains p_request_id (idempotent via lightning_hand.request_id, unique), locks anchor seats FOR SHARE, freezes the Cluster on an impossible state (PLT02, stack_invariant_failed, cluster_frozen) and retries only races. begin_dealing re-checks the Cluster and the participants and abandons with a reason; slots_sync takes cash_games FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED and obeys the pass deadline; the tick stands down before locking; each stuck-conversion abort is isolated. cash_cluster_events gains event_version and request_id and the specification events; cash_cluster_conversion gains chips_at_begin and chips_at_commit; lightning_blind_ledger gains debt_since (kept by trg_lightning_blind_ledger_tracks_debt_since) which the P2 key now reads. DELETE is revoked from service_role on the seven lightning tables and cash_cluster_conversion. Re-cut functions are listed because the nightly refresh must find them carrying the new bodies.
